name: Jet Amplifier - Vigilant
RelatedDescription: This jetpack enables an ST to fly over short distances, quickly traversing obstacles to reach even the most inaccessible corners of the battlefield. Also integrates a function that enhances the ST's Vigilant capability.

61239.name: Flying Device I · Vigilant
61239.SpecificEffects:
ST Move Method changes to levitation, enabling ST to pass over low obstacles.
When launching Vigilant Shot, Hit Rate <color=#F74848>+15%</color> and Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+10%</color>.
ST Body's HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color>, DMG Dealt <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
